findings.evidence: The segmented carapace behind the head is taller and bulkier than the head and rises into a hump, so the head is not the broadest part and the hindquarters do not slope down into a forward wedge.

findings.where: ear fins on top of head
findings.evidence: The two triangular fins point straight up like cat ears instead of sweeping back.
The ivory pieces are two long downward-curving fangs, not short split insect-like mandibles.

findings.where: background under body and around feet
findings.evidence: A soft grey shadow pools on the background beneath the creature and its toes, although the spec asks for no cast shadow.
